    <h1 style="text-align:justify"><strong>Unlock Hidden Productivity Tools: Exploring Lesser-Known Microsoft 365 Tools</strong></h1>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Author: Udhaya A, Automation Consultant, Atna Technologies</strong></p>

<p style="text-align:justify">In our day-to-day work routine, we often rely on the various tools from Microsoft 365 world which includes Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint and Teams. But did you know that hidden within the 9-dot logo, there are some incredible productivity tools we might be missing out on? Let’s look at a few of these lesser-known tools that can take our efficiency and collaboration to the next level.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Microsoft Planner: Simplifying Task Management</strong></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><img alt="Microsoft Planner" src="/ckfinder/userfiles/files/image.png" style="float:left; height:94px; margin-left:20px; margin-right:20px; width:100px" />Planner is our go-to for visual task management. It helps us organize our work visually, making it easy to create plans, assign tasks, and track progress. With visual task boards, we can customize and drag-and-drop tasks to keep everything organized. Plus, Planner boards can be embedded right into our Teams channels for seamless collaboration. Don’t forget the due dates and notifications to help us stay on track with deadlines.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify"> </p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Microsoft To Do: Personal Task Management </strong></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><img alt="Microsoft To Do: Personal Task Management " src="/ckfinder/userfiles/files/image(1).png" style="float:left; height:82px; margin-left:20px; margin-right:20px; width:100px" />For our personal and professional tasks, Microsoft To Do is a lifesaver. It’s simple yet powerful, keeping all our to-dos in one place. We can sort tasks by priority and due date, and the “My Day” feature helps us focus on what’s important today. The best part? It syncs with Outlook for a unified task management experience.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify"> </p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Microsoft Lists: Advanced Information Tracking </strong></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><img alt="Microsoft Lists" src="/ckfinder/userfiles/files/image(2).png" style="float:left; height:100px; margin-left:20px; margin-right:20px; width:100px" />Lists is perfect for tracking information and organizing work. Whether it’s issue tracking, asset management, or event planning, Lists has got us covered. We can use customizable templates for common scenarios and get started quickly. With integration with Power Automate, we can automate workflows to update lists and notify team members of changes. Plus, we can customize list items with rich text, links, and attachments.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify"> </p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Microsoft Whiteboard: Collaborative Brainstorming  </strong></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><img alt="Microsoft Whiteboard" src="/ckfinder/userfiles/files/image(3).png" style="float:left; height:88px; margin-left:20px; margin-right:20px; width:100px" />When it’s time to brainstorm, Microsoft Whiteboard is our digital canvas. It’s perfect for sketching ideas, creating diagrams, and writing notes. There’s endless space to let our ideas flow, and we can work with team members simultaneously, seeing their changes in real-time. Templates and sticky notes help us organize thoughts and streamline brainstorming sessions.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><br />
<strong>Microsoft Loop: Fluid Collaboration   </strong></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><img alt="Microsoft Loop" src="/ckfinder/userfiles/files/image(4).png" style="float:left; height:100px; margin-left:20px; margin-right:20px; width:100px" />Loop is designed to bring our content and tasks together across Microsoft 365 into flexible, portable pieces that stay in sync. We can collaborate on content across different apps in real-time, and create and share lists, tables, and notes that can be embedded in various apps. Loop seamlessly integrates with Word, Excel, and Teams for fluid collaboration.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify"> </p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Microsoft Sway: Dynamic Presentations    </strong></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><img alt="Microsoft Sway" src="/ckfinder/userfiles/files/image(5).png" style="float:left; height:87px; margin-left:20px; margin-right:20px; width:100px" />For creating visually appealing, interactive presentations, Sway is a game-changer. No advanced design skills are needed to create professional presentations. We can incorporate videos, images, and interactive charts effortlessly, and our presentations will look great on any device, adapting to different screen sizes.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify"> </p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Microsoft Viva Engage: Enhanced Employee Engagement     </strong> <br />
<img alt="Microsoft Viva Engage" src="/ckfinder/userfiles/files/image(6).png" style="float:left; height:100px; margin-left:20px; margin-right:20px; width:100px" />Viva Engage (formerly Yammer) helps us build community and enhance communication within our organization. We can create and join groups to share knowledge and collaborate, encouraging open communication and idea sharing across all levels. It seamlessly integrates with Teams and SharePoint.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify"> </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">As a Microsoft Certified Partner, we owe it to ourselves to explore and utilize these powerful productivity tools. By familiarizing ourselves with these tools, we can enhance our workflow. Let’s start exploring these hidden gems and unlock new levels of productivity and collaboration within our organization!</p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><br />
Happy exploring!<br />
 </p>

    <h1 style="text-align:justify"><strong>Boost Your Efficiency with Copilot in Business Central: A Step-by-Step Guide to Bank Account Reconciliation </strong></h1>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Author: Kirthivasan, Fu<span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">nctional Consultant, Atna Technologies</span></strong></p>

<p style="text-align:justify">In the ever-evolving world of business management software, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central stands out as a comprehensive solution for small to medium-sized enterprises. Among its myriad features, the integration of AI-driven tools like Copilot significantly enhances productivity and accuracy. In this blog post, we'll explore how Copilot can streamline your financial operations, specifically focusing on the process of bank account reconciliation. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>What is Copilot in Business Central? </strong></p>

<p style="text-align:justify">Copilot is an AI-powered assistant integrated within Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. By leveraging advanced technologies, Copilot helps users navigate and utilize the software more effectively. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Features of Copilot </strong></p>

<p style="text-align:justify">1. Natural Language Processing (NLP): Copilot understands and processes natural language queries, making it easier for users to interact with the system. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">2. Suggestions for Data Entry and Task Completion: It provides intelligent suggestions to simplify data entry and task completion. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">3. Predictive Analytics for Decision-Making Support: Copilot uses predictive analytics to offer insights and recommendations, aiding in better decision-making. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>How Does Copilot Work? </strong></p>

<p style="text-align:justify">1. User Interaction: Users interact with Copilot using natural language queries. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">2. AI Processing: Copilot utilizes machine learning algorithms to understand user intent. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">3. Response: Copilot provides suggestions, recommendations, and insights based on user queries and historical data. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>The Importance of Bank Account Reconciliation </strong></p>

<p style="text-align:justify">Bank account reconciliation is a critical financial process that ensures the accuracy of your company's financial records by comparing your bank statements with your accounting records. Regular reconciliation helps in identifying discrepancies, detecting fraud, and maintaining financial integrity. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Using Copilot for Bank Account Reconciliation </strong></p>

<p style="text-align:justify">Let's dive into how Copilot can assist you with bank account reconciliation in Business Central. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Step 1:</strong> Import Bank Statements </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">The first step in bank account reconciliation is to import your bank statements into Business Central. Copilot simplifies this by automatically mapping the fields from your bank statement to the corresponding fields in Business Central. This reduces the manual effort required and ensures accuracy. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">1. Navigate to the Bank Account Reconciliation Page: </p>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p style="text-align:justify">Go to the Cash Management module. </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p style="text-align:justify">Select Bank Account Reconciliation. </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<p style="text-align:justify">2. Import the Bank Statement: </p>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p style="text-align:justify">Click on Import Bank Statement. </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p style="text-align:justify">Select the file you wish to import. </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p style="text-align:justify">Copilot will automatically map the fields and provide a preview. </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Step 2:</strong> Match Transactions </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">Once your bank statement is imported, the next step is to match the transactions in your bank statement with those in your accounting records. Copilot uses machine learning algorithms to suggest matches based on the transaction amount, date, and description. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">1. Review Suggested Matches: </p>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p style="text-align:justify">The copilot will present you with suggested matches for each transaction. </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p style="text-align:justify">Review the suggestions and approve them if they are accurate. </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<p style="text-align:justify">2. Manual Matching: </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">For any unmatched transactions, Copilot will provide recommendations based on historical data. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">You can manually match these transactions by selecting the appropriate entries from your accounting records. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Step 3:</strong> Resolve Discrepancies </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">Discrepancies between your bank statement and accounting records can occur due to various reasons such as bank fees, errors, or fraudulent activities. Copilot helps in identifying and resolving these discrepancies efficiently. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">1. Identify Discrepancies: </p>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p style="text-align:justify">Copilot highlights any discrepancies for your review. </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p style="text-align:justify">It categorizes them based on common reasons, such as timing differences or errors. </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<p style="text-align:justify">2. Take Corrective Actions: </p>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p style="text-align:justify">Copilot provides suggestions for resolving discrepancies, such as adjusting entries or investigating potential errors. </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p style="text-align:justify">Implement the suggested corrective actions to reconcile the discrepancies. </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Step 4:</strong> Finalize Reconciliation </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">After matching transactions and resolving discrepancies, the final step is to finalize the reconciliation. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">1. Review the Reconciliation Summary: </p>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p style="text-align:justify">Copilot generates a reconciliation summary for your review. </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p style="text-align:justify">Ensure that all transactions are matched, and discrepancies are resolved. </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<p style="text-align:justify">2. Post the Reconciliation: </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">Once satisfied, post the reconciliation to update your financial records. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Benefits of Using Copilot for Bank Account Reconciliation </strong></p>

<p style="text-align:justify">1. Timesaving: Automating repetitive tasks with Copilot reduces the time spent on manual data entry and transaction matching. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">2. Accuracy: Copilot's intelligent suggestions and automated processes minimize human error, ensuring accurate reconciliation. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">3. Insightful Analysis: Copilot provides valuable insights and recommendations, helping you make informed decisions and maintain financial health. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">4. Enhanced Productivity: With Copilot handling routine tasks, your finance team can focus on more strategic activities, driving overall productivity. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify">Copilot in Business Central is a game-changer for financial operations, making complex processes like bank account reconciliation more manageable and efficient. By automating routine tasks and providing intelligent insights, Copilot empowers businesses to maintain accurate financial records with ease. Embrace the power of AI-driven tools in Business Central to streamline your financial processes and drive your business forward. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Author: Dr. S. Gomathi, L&D Head, Atna Technologies</strong></p>

<p style="text-align:justify">In the dynamic landscape of technology, staying ahead requires constant upskilling and mastery. This month, we are thrilled to introduce the MB-820 certification, a transformative credential reshaping the realm of Business Central development. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>What is MB-820? </strong></p>

<p style="text-align:justify">The MB-820 certification, or the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Developer Associate certification, is tailored for professionals aiming to excel in designing and customizing solutions using Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. It equips developers with the expertise to expand Business Central applications to meet diverse enterprise needs effectively. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><strong>Advantages of MB-820: Enhanced Proficiency in Development </strong></p>

    <p><strong><span style="font-size:22px">SIMPLIFY FINANCIAL CONSOLIDATION AND REPORTING WITH FINCON</span></strong><br />
<br />
<span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">In today’s dynamic business environment, finance teams are expected to close the books faster, deliver accurate consolidated reports, and provide real-time insights to decision-makers. But when financial data lives across multiple entities, currencies, and ERP systems achieving this level of efficiency becomes a constant uphill battle.<br />
<br />
<strong>FINCON by ATNA Technologies changes that narrative.</strong></span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">It’s a modern financial consolidation and reporting platform built to bring <strong>automation, intelligence, and transparency</strong> to finance operations enabling teams to move from data chaos to strategic clarity.</span></span></p>

<h2><span style="font-size:16pt"><span style="font-family:"Calibri Light",sans-serif"><span style="color:#2f5496">The Real Challenge Behind Financial Consolidation</span></span></span></h2>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Every CFO, Finance Controller, and FP&A leader knows the story.</span></span></p>

<ul>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Endless spreadsheets.</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Manual reconciliations.</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Mismatched trial balances.</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Intercompany transactions.<br />
	And reports that change until the very last minute.</span></span></li>
</ul>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">For organizations operating across multiple geographies, consolidation becomes a bottleneck, often overshadowing strategic decision-making.</span></span></p>

<h2><span style="font-size:16pt"><span style="font-family:"Calibri Light",sans-serif"><span style="color:#2f5496">Common Pain Points</span></span></span></h2>

<ul>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Manual data collection & reconciliations that increase human errors</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Complex intercompany eliminations</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Subsidiaries using inconsistent charts of accounts</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Limited visibility across regions & business units</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Compliance-heavy audits with missing traceability</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Long and stressful month-end & year-end close cycles</span></span></li>
</ul>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Finance teams today spend <strong>80% of their time collecting and reconciling data</strong>, and only <strong>20% analysing it</strong>.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">It’s time to reverse that ratio.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Finance leaders don't just need a tool —<br />
<strong>They need an intelligent platform that simplifies consolidation and enables high-quality insights.</strong></span></span></p>

<h2><span style="font-size:16pt"><span style="font-family:"Calibri Light",sans-serif"><span style="color:#2f5496">Enter FINCON: One Platform. Complete Financial Clarity.</span></span></span></h2>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">FINCON unifies all financial data into a <strong>single source of truth</strong>, integrating effortlessly with cloud ERPs, legacy on-prem systems, and even Excel.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">It auto-structures, cleans, and maps data for consolidation — eliminating manual work and reducing errors.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">With <strong>automated consolidation</strong>, <strong>dynamic COA mapping</strong>, and <strong>multi-currency intelligence</strong>, FINCON empowers finance teams to deliver real-time, audit-ready reports with confidence.</span></span></p>

<h2><span style="font-size:16pt"><span style="font-family:"Calibri Light",sans-serif"><span style="color:#2f5496">Key Features That Transform Financial Operations</span></span></span></h2>

<ol>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><strong>Dynamic Chart of Accounts (COA) Mapping</strong></span></span>: <span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Automatically map accounts from multiple systems into a unified structure for consistent reporting.</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><strong>Multi-Currency Support</strong></span></span>: <span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Consolidate global entities effortlessly with automated FX conversion and reporting.</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><strong>Intercompany Reconciliation</strong></span></span>: <span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Built-in workflows simplify and automate intercompany adjustments and eliminations.</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><strong>Budget Management & Variance Insights</strong></span></span>: <span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Compare budget vs actuals, generate forecasts, and track scenario performance Compare budget vs actuals, generate forecasts, and track scenario performance, all with built-in data governance and enterprise-grade security.  </span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><strong>Customizable Dashboards & Reports</strong></span></span>: <span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Visual reporting with drilldowns enabling CFOs and teams to move from macro to micro insight instantly.</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:14pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><strong><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Ready-to-Use Financial Reports</span></strong></span></span>: <span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Prebuilt, audit-ready reports including Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement, and Group Consolidation Reports.</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><strong>Fast Implementation</strong></span></span>: <span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Prebuilt connectors for Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle, Business Central, NAV, Tally, QuickBooks, and Excel accelerate your go live.</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><strong>Advanced Visual Reporting</strong></span></span>: <span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Interactive dashboards with drill-through, hierarchy expansion, variance insights, and comparative reporting.</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><strong>Mobile Access</strong></span></span>: <span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Review reports, dashboards, and KPIs on the go — anytime, anywhere.</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><strong>Automated PAT Transfer</strong></span></span>: <span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Automatically transfer Profit After Tax to reserves during close cycles.</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:14pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><strong><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Financial Warehousing:</span></strong></span></span> <span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">FINCON supports On-Premises, Azure, and Microsoft Fabric-based financial data warehouses for scalable and secure enterprise reporting.</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:14pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><strong><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Input Management:</span></strong></span></span> <span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Applications for exchange rates, hierarchy inputs, and provisions — all integrated directly into consolidated reports.</span></span></li>
</ol>

<h2><span style="font-size:16pt"><span style="font-family:"Calibri Light",sans-serif"><span style="color:#2f5496">Finance Dashboard: Bringing Financial Performance to Life</span></span></span></h2>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">A finance dashboard built inside FINCON acts as an <em>interactive window</em> into your company’s financial health.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">With it, finance teams can:</span></span></p>

<ul>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Implement better cost & margin management</span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Track expenses, revenue, and profitability</span></span></li>

	<li><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">Align financial performance with business goals</span></span></li>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif">It turns your consolidation platform into a decision-making engine.</span></span></p>

    <div class="blog-wrapper">
<div class="section-card">
<p>In manufacturing, small data mismatches can lead to large financial consequences. One of the most common yet overlooked issues is the gap between the Bill of Materials (BOM) and actual shop floor consumption.</p>

<p>This problem, known as BOM drift, occurs when real-world production deviates from planned material usage. While BOM is considered the backbone of production planning, it often fails to keep up with real-time changes on the shop floor.</p>

<p>The result? Increased inventory costs, production disruptions, and inefficient supply chain planning.</p>
</div>

<div class="section-card">
<h4><strong><span style="color:#2980b9">Understanding BOM Drift in Manufacturing</span></strong></h4>

<p><strong>BOM drift typically arises due to:</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>Delays in updating BOM after engineering changes</li>
	<li>Manual adjustments made during production</li>
	<li>Lack of synchronization between PLM, ERP, and shop floor systems</li>
</ul>

<p>When this happens, planned consumption and actual usage no longer align.</p>
</div>

<div class="section-card">
<h4><strong><span style="color:#2980b9">Business Impact</span></strong></h4>

<ul>
	<li>Stock-outs when materials are consumed faster than expected</li>
	<li>Excess inventory when unused materials are over-procured</li>
	<li>Higher inventory carrying costs</li>
	<li>Inefficient vendor commitments</li>
</ul>

<p>Over time, these issues reduce operational efficiency and tie up valuable working capital.</p>
</div>

<div class="section-card">
<h4><strong><span style="color:#2980b9">Why Fixing the BOM Alone Isn’t Enough?</span></strong></h4>

<p>Most organizations attempt to resolve this issue by updating the BOM. However, in large enterprises, this process is often slow and complex.</p>

<p>BOM updates involve multiple systems and approvals, making it difficult to keep pace with continuous shop floor changes. By the time corrections are made, planning decisions have already been impacted.</p>

<p>This is why businesses need a smarter approach—one that focuses on real-time consumption visibility rather than relying solely on static BOM data.</p>
</div>

<div class="section-card">
<h4><strong><span style="color:#2980b9">How ATNA Planning Optimizer Addresses BOM Mismatch</span></strong></h4>

<div class="highlight">
<p><strong>Flow Rate-Based Planning</strong></p>

<p>At the core of the solution is the concept of Flow Rate, which tracks actual material consumption dynamically.</p>
</div>

<p>It enables:</p>

<ul>
	<li>Continuous monitoring of actual component usage</li>
	<li>Real-time comparison with planned BOM consumption</li>
	<li>Immediate identification of consumption variances</li>
	<li>Faster, data-driven decision-making</li>
</ul>

<p>This approach helps planners act proactively instead of reacting to issues after they occur.</p>
</div>

<div class="section-card">
<h4><strong><span style="color:#2980b9">Use Case: Automotive Manufacturing Example</span></strong></h4>

<p>Consider an automotive manufacturer producing braking systems.</p>

<p>A minor change on the shop floor leads to the use of two washers instead of one per unit. However, the BOM is not updated immediately.</p>

<p><strong>Without Planning Optimizer</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>Procurement continues ordering based on outdated BOM</li>
	<li>Washer usage increases unexpectedly, causing stock-outs</li>
	<li>Other materials become excess due to incorrect planning</li>
	<li>Emergency purchases increase operational costs</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>With ATNA Planning Optimizer</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>The system detects a higher actual flow rate of washers</li>
	<li>Variance from planned consumption is flagged instantly</li>
	<li>Planners adjust procurement before shortages occur</li>
	<li>Inventory remains balanced and optimized</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Result</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>Reduced inventory waste</li>
	<li>Improved production continuity</li>
	<li>Lower procurement costs</li>
	<li>Enhanced supply chain visibility</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="section-card">
<h4><strong><span style="color:#2980b9">Conclusion: From Reactive to Proactive Planning</span></strong></h4>

<p>In today’s fast-paced manufacturing environment, relying solely on BOM is no longer sufficient.</p>

<p>To achieve effective inventory optimization and supply chain efficiency, organizations must bridge the gap between planning and execution.</p>

<p>ATNA Planning Optimizer enables this shift by providing real-time insights into actual consumption, helping businesses prevent stock-outs, reduce excess inventory, and optimize working capital.</p>

<p>Ultimately, better visibility leads to smarter decisions—and smarter decisions drive better business outcomes.</p>
</div>

</div>

    <p>In today’s fast-moving supply chains, accuracy in supply chain planning isn’t just important it’s critical. Yet many organizations still rely on Excel spreadsheets to bridge the gap between what their ERP systems capture and what’s actually happening on the ground. </p>

<p>This disconnect leads to hidden inefficiencies, MRP planning errors, and missed opportunities that directly impact manufacturing operations. </p>

<p>The real challenge isn’t the lack of data, it’s the inability to incorporate real-time shop floor insights into the planning process in a structured, scalable way. </p>

<h4><span style="color:#2980b9"><strong>Use Case: Non-Conforming Inventory Impacting MRP Planning </strong></span></h4>

<p>A production planner walks the warehouse floor during inbound inspection and notices a batch of material that doesn’t meet specifications — wrong color, incorrect grade, or failed quality check. </p>

<p>The issue hasn’t yet been updated in the ERP system. </p>

<p>Planner knows the material is unusable. <br />
But the system still considers it available inventory. </p>

<h4><strong><span style="color:#2980b9">What Happens Next </span></strong></h4>

<p>When Material Requirements Planning (MRP) runs, it processes the available inventory as valid stock: </p>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p>Net demand is reduced  </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p>Purchase quantities are automatically adjusted downward  </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p>Procurement signals are suppressed  </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<p>From the system’s perspective, everything is working correctly. </p>

<p>But in reality, the MRP output is already flawed. </p>

<h4><strong><span style="color:#2980b9">Planner’s Dilemma </span></strong></h4>

<p>The planner is now forced to make a decision: </p>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p><strong>Option 1:</strong> Let the system run as is <br />
	→ Risk a production line stoppage due to stockout  </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p><strong>Option 2:</strong> Override the system manually <br />
	→ Open Excel, adjust the numbers, and fix the purchase order  </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<p>The planner chooses Excel. Every time. </p>

<h4><span style="color:#2980b9"><strong>The Hidden Business Impact of Excel-Based Planning </strong></span></h4>

<p>This workaround solves the immediate issue, but creates a much bigger, invisible problem for the organization: </p>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p>No audit trail of the decision  </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<ul>
	<li>
	<p>No visibility across procurement and operations teams  </p>
	</li>
</ul>

<ul>
	<li>

<div class="section-card">
<p>In manufacturing, small data mismatches can lead to large financial consequences. One of the most common yet overlooked issues is the gap between the Bill of Materials (BOM) and actual shop floor consumption.</p>

<p>This problem, known as BOM drift, occurs when real-world production deviates from planned material usage. While BOM is considered the backbone of production planning, it often fails to keep up with real-time changes on the shop floor.</p>

<p>The result? Increased inventory costs, production disruptions, and inefficient supply chain planning.</p>
</div>

<div class="section-card">
<h4><strong><span style="color:#2980b9">Understanding BOM Drift in Manufacturing</span></strong></h4>

<p><strong>BOM drift typically arises due to:</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>Delays in updating BOM after engineering changes</li>
	<li>Manual adjustments made during production</li>
	<li>Lack of synchronization between PLM, ERP, and shop floor systems</li>
</ul>

<p>When this happens, planned consumption and actual usage no longer align.</p>
</div>

<div class="section-card">
<h4><strong><span style="color:#2980b9">Business Impact</span></strong></h4>

<ul>
	<li>Stock-outs when materials are consumed faster than expected</li>
	<li>Excess inventory when unused materials are over-procured</li>
	<li>Higher inventory carrying costs</li>
	<li>Inefficient vendor commitments</li>
</ul>

<p>Over time, these issues reduce operational efficiency and tie up valuable working capital.</p>
</div>

<div class="section-card">
<h4><strong><span style="color:#2980b9">Why Fixing the BOM Alone Isn’t Enough?</span></strong></h4>

<p>Most organizations attempt to resolve this issue by updating the BOM. However, in large enterprises, this process is often slow and complex.</p>

<p>BOM updates involve multiple systems and approvals, making it difficult to keep pace with continuous shop floor changes. By the time corrections are made, planning decisions have already been impacted.</p>

<p>This is why businesses need a smarter approach—one that focuses on real-time consumption visibility rather than relying solely on static BOM data.</p>
</div>

<div class="section-card">
<h4><strong><span style="color:#2980b9">How ATNA Planning Optimizer Addresses BOM Mismatch</span></strong></h4>

<div class="highlight">
<p><strong>Flow Rate-Based Planning</strong></p>

<p>At the core of the solution is the concept of Flow Rate, which tracks actual material consumption dynamically.</p>
</div>

<p>It enables:</p>

<ul>
	<li>Continuous monitoring of actual component usage</li>
	<li>Real-time comparison with planned BOM consumption</li>
	<li>Immediate identification of consumption variances</li>
	<li>Faster, data-driven decision-making</li>
</ul>

<p>This approach helps planners act proactively instead of reacting to issues after they occur.</p>
</div>

<div class="section-card">
<h4><strong><span style="color:#2980b9">Use Case: Automotive Manufacturing Example</span></strong></h4>

<p>Consider an automotive manufacturer producing braking systems.</p>

<p>A minor change on the shop floor leads to the use of two washers instead of one per unit. However, the BOM is not updated immediately.</p>

<p><strong>Without Planning Optimizer</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>Procurement continues ordering based on outdated BOM</li>
	<li>Washer usage increases unexpectedly, causing stock-outs</li>
	<li>Other materials become excess due to incorrect planning</li>
	<li>Emergency purchases increase operational costs</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>With ATNA Planning Optimizer</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>The system detects a higher actual flow rate of washers</li>
	<li>Variance from planned consumption is flagged instantly</li>
	<li>Planners adjust procurement before shortages occur</li>
	<li>Inventory remains balanced and optimized</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Result</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>Reduced inventory waste</li>
	<li>Improved production continuity</li>
	<li>Lower procurement costs</li>
	<li>Enhanced supply chain visibility</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="section-card">
<h4><strong><span style="color:#2980b9">Conclusion: From Reactive to Proactive Planning</span></strong></h4>

<p>In today’s fast-paced manufacturing environment, relying solely on BOM is no longer sufficient.</p>
